blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. A 3-hour city tour with an English-speaking guide takes you through La Boca, San Telmo and Plaza Dorrego, Plaza de Mayo with Casa Rosada, the Obelisk on Avenida 9 de Julio, Recoleta with its cemetery and the Basilica of El Pilar, Puerto Madero, Lezama Park and Parque Tres de Febrero.

In the evening, a tango show with dinner is included, without a guide. The restaurant serves traditional dishes and Argentine wines, while dancers perform on stage.
